skills.name: seaworthy-adopt
skills.description: Adopt Seaworthy verification in an existing site in four moves - a first honest look that fails nothing, a committed baseline that freezes today's findings, a CI gate that fails only on new ones, and a status badge once the gate is green. Use when a site already has findings and a day-one gate would start the project with red CI.

skills.name: seaworthy-verify
skills.description: Runs the Seaworthy verify-and-fix loop on a built static site — verify the built output, read the findings by check ID and location, fix the source, re-verify, and stop at the exit-code gate. Use when an agent has just built or changed a website and needs to know what is broken and how to fix it, when the user asks to "verify the site", "run seaworthy", or check a site for broken links, accessibility, or agent-readability problems, or before the agent says a site is done. Do not use it to adopt Seaworthy into CI or to park existing debt; that is a separate skill.
